profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With over a decade of software engineering experience, primarily in Ruby on Rails, I continue to pursue my passion for SOLID maintainable code that delights end users and engineers alike.

I have experience working in a distributed architecture as well as in a monolith. I've delivered major features both independently and collaboratively. I've led individual projects and served as a Tech Lead for a scrum team for 2 years.

I've developed ideas from inception to delivery. I've mentored junior engineers, motivated and inspired others, and communicated cross-functionally to build alignment. I enjoy celebrating individual achievements as well as the collective achievements of a team. I share credit generously.

I'm passionate about my work, but I hold my opinions lightly. I value integrity and intellectual rigor above all else. I endeavor to share my perspectives honestly and to argue persuasively, but I don't hesitate to admit when I'm wrong. I enjoy having my thinking challenged. I appreciate honest feedback that makes me better.

I've worked in healthy engineering cultures and in not-so-healthy engineering cultures. Debate practices should prioritize openness and respect, and all viewpoints should be valued. Decisions should not depend on perfect information, but rushing to action can set back a timeline with wrong turns. Work time should be scheduled with care to allow for individual flexibility, to provide ample time for deep focus, and to enable fruitful conversations. To achieve velocity, a team must constantly seek to balance competing imperatives.

I find the creativity and craftsmanship of software engineering to be deeply satisfying, but I want more out of my career than the simple joy of coding. I make my career decisions with the hope that when I reach the end of my career, I'll be able to look back with pride on both the quality and the positive impact of my years of work.

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
Developed and maintained web applications using ajax methodologies and a model-view-controller framework in a Linux-based development environment favoring open source technologies, primarily:

   •	JavaScript
   •	HTML/CSS
   •	Perl
   •	MySQL
   •	Git

Assumed lead role in developing an internal web application from initial design to production release:

   •	Wrote nearly all client-side code
   •	Wrote a large portion of server-side code, including all SQL queries
   •	Led the defining of technical specifications
   •	Designed the MySQL database tables
   •	Designed the front-end architecture and contributed to the design of the back-end architecture

Trained an intern.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Maydm creates space for girls and students of color to flourish in technology through after school programs, STEM programs, and beginner computer science.

I began volunteering as a mentor in the summer web development program in 2019. I've worked with some impressive kids and have found the experience personally inspiring. Diversity in technology is crucially and urgently needed, and I'm grateful for the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to the cause.
